input.legs: array of leg inputs; triathlon uses separate run/bike/swim plus transitions

leg.segments: optional array of surfaceDistanceM, riseM, horizontalDistanceM, headingDeg, surface, speedCapMps; sum distance reconciled
leg.timeModifier: explicit positive user factor with label; null means not modeled
leg.runningPowerW: optional same-device user target with deviceId; never computed from pace

weather.coverage: forecast must cover complete modeled event; no synthetic future weather

input.sensitivityCases: named explicit alternative input bundles, not random confidence samples

output.totalMechanicalWorkKj: only power-observed/modeled bicycle work; null where unavailable, never treated as all-sport energy
output.fuelCarbsG: practicedCarbsGph*eligible planned intake duration h, with delivery-window feasibility
output.provenance: immutable calculation input snapshot, model version and source references

gates: Reject NaN, Infinity, numeric strings unless explicitly parsed, negative distance, duplicate leg IDs, unknown enum values and out-of-range humidity/efficiency.
Do not derive bike speed without explicit mass/CdA/Crr/density/etaDrive and target power.
Do not derive HR from age/FTP/pace; absent remains absent.
Do not derive running power from pace.
Do not apply time target from run5k to other distances as observed sustainable pace; selected target must be visibly confirmed.
No automatic heat/humidity/altitude/acclimation or fatigue adjustment.
No generic grade model for sprint/swim/HYROX station.
No automatic grade extrapolation beyond +/-0.15 product gate; require manual target.
FTP/CP are reference labels not long-event sustainable power guarantees.
No calibrated confidence level unless independently validated.
Null missing finish components makes whole-event total null while known components remain available.

numericTests.expected: C=2.151706 J/kg/m; do not turn metabolic ratio into uncapped trail speed
dependent output null with missingInputs; no default athlete

numericTests.inputs: descent speed cap requiring negative crank power
numericTests.expected: 0W crank; braking flag, no negative work

implementation.note: The input/output sections above describe the broader research design, not an exact JSON schema. TypeScript interfaces and strict parser are authoritative for the shipped subset.
implementation.validation: 23 focused engine tests passing; see the verification report for full integration and build evidence
implementation.course: Segment distanceM is ALONG-PATH distance; GPX horizontal run must be converted and leg totals reconciled. Empty run/bike segments require flatCourseConfirmed true.
implementation.recency: 90-day product review gate on baseline/intensity/fuel; not physiological expiry. Future actual observation dates invalid.
implementation.power: powerW selected target, actualAveragePowerW realized model result, segment actualPowerW includes cap/coasting behavior. Cycling timeMultiplier fixed1.
implementation.evidence: intensityEvidence and fuelEvidence require date/source/context/confirmed; running power additionally requires runPowerDevice.
implementation.swimFuel: Standalone swim intake remains null because feeding windows are not modeled. Triathlon scheduling counts bike+run only.
implementation.sensitivity: Explicit symmetric elapsed-time sensitivity percent, not model uncertainty/confidence.
implementation.weather: Weather contextual only; unknown never synthetic actual; complete forecast validity checked but automatic wind projection/provider fetch owned outside engine.
